title: #2229 Surface empty BCPT results as a warning instead of silent success
summary: BCPT performance tests that run but produce no log entries now show a warning instead of silently succeeding, making empty results visible in the GitHub step summary.

title: #2257 Test Result Analyzer fails if no stack trace is available
summary: Fixed Test Result Analyzer to handle XML elements without stack traces by using InnerText instead of the potentially null text property.

title: #2283 Fix issue 2267: appsourcecop.json is not created for testapps
summary: Test and BCPT apps now generate appsourcecop.json files when code analyzers are enabled on test apps, preventing AS0054 compilation failures.

title: #2286 fix: Refactor GetModifiedSettingsContent for PS5 compatibility
summary: The GetModifiedSettingsContent function now explicitly lists property names instead of using wildcards in Select-Object to ensure compatibility with PowerShell 5.

title: #2300 Make failOn: newWarning work with workspace compilation
summary: The failOn: newWarning setting now detects newly introduced AL compiler warnings when workspace compilation is enabled, by running the check during the compile phase instead of the pipeline phase and handling workspace-format compiler output.

title: #2301 Provide package cache to aldoc when building reference documentation
summary: The aldoc command now receives a populated package cache to resolve cross-module references in generated reference documentation, fixing unresolved links that occurred when building documentation for artifact-based apps.

title: #2304 Support framework-dependent (flat) AL Language extension layout
summary: AL-Go now supports framework-dependent AL Language extensions with flat internal layout by making path resolution aware of both nested and flat folder structures for altool, analyzers, and aldoc.

title: #2313 Fix dependency resolution when branch name contains ']' character
summary: Fixed dependency resolution in GitHub Helper to correctly handle branch names containing the ] character by using literal path interpretation instead of wildcard matching.

title: #2314 Retry current-build dependency artifact download up to 3 times
summary: The Download Project Dependencies action now retries failed artifact downloads up to 3 times with 30-second delays between attempts to handle transient network errors from GitHub's Actions Results service.

title: #2321 fix: error on delivery of multiple release artifacts of same project
summary: The CreateRelease workflow now prevents redundant artifact deliveries by only running NuGet and Storage delivery steps when the matrix processes the Apps artifact type, eliminating duplicate delivery attempts.

title: #2323 Fix enableCodeAnalyzersOnTestApps not disabling customCodeCops in workspace compilation
summary: Workspace compilation now correctly disables custom code analyzers when enableCodeAnalyzersOnTestApps is false, preventing custom analyzer diagnostics from running against test apps.

title: #2327 Add doNotPerformUpgrade setting and enhance upgrade warning messages
summary: AL-Go pipeline now supports skipping the upgrade phase with a new doNotPerformUpgrade setting while continuing to publish and test apps. Warning messages about upgrade testing have also been improved.

title: #2328 Use cacheImageName for local development environments
summary: Local development environments now use the configured cacheImageName setting to enable reuse of cached Business Central images, reducing container creation time by avoiding repeated Business Central installations.

title: #2330 Emit valid SARIF URIs for AL code analysis paths containing spaces
summary: ProcessALCodeAnalysisLogs now properly URI-encodes file paths with spaces in SARIF output to comply with URI standards and prevent upload warnings.

title: #2331 Support trackALAlertsInGitHub for workspace compilation build path
summary: AL-Go now produces error log files during workspace compilation when GitHub code scanning alerts are enabled, allowing AL compiler diagnostics to surface as code scanning alerts in the workspace build path.

title: #2334 Handle app names with underscores correctly for reference documentation
summary: AL-Go now handles underscores in app names consistently with AlDoc by preserving underscores instead of converting them to dashes when generating reference documentation paths.

title: #2340 Add opt-in unpublishOldVersions setting to unpublish stale PTE app versions after deploy
summary: AL-Go now supports an opt-in setting to automatically unpublish old, uninstalled versions of Per Tenant Extensions after deployment, keeping the Extension Management list clean and reducing clutter.

title: #2342 Fix incremental builds poisoning buildMode-specific artifacts (#2337)
summary: Fixed incremental builds in AL-Go that were corrupting buildMode-specific artifacts by re-publishing default build mode apps under incorrect artifact names, causing dependent projects to fail with runtime version mismatches.

title: #2346 Pin all actions that are not currently pinned
summary: Pinned unpinned GitHub Actions to specific versions across Power Platform deployment workflows and updated the dependabot configuration to manage these pinned versions.

title: #2355 Move CreateRelease update check to separate job
summary: The AL-Go CreateRelease workflow now runs update checks in a separate, parallel job instead of blocking release creation, allowing faster releases while keeping the check non-blocking.

title: #2367 Enhance NuGet feed selection to support pre-release packages
summary: AL-Go now supports pre-release NuGet packages by adding an `-allowPrerelease` suffix to the nuGetFeedSelectMode setting, enabling developers to include pre-release versions in dependency resolution.

title: #2376 fix: modified files with umlauts
summary: Incremental build detection now correctly handles project and app paths containing special characters like umlauts and German characters by disabling git escaping and setting UTF-8 encoding.

title: #2378 Retry CI/CD baseline discovery when no eligible run is found
summary: AL-Go now retries CI/CD baseline discovery up to three times when the GitHub workflow-runs API returns incomplete results, with backoff pauses between attempts and pagination resets to avoid missing eligible baselines.

title: #2379 Avoid CI/CD runs for template SHA-only system updates
summary: The system no longer commits template SHA changes when only an empty commit occurs in the template repository, preventing unnecessary CI/CD triggers with no actual file modifications.

title: #2380 Fix device login initialization with a shared authentication action
summary: A shared authentication action now handles device login initialization for AL-Go workflows, ensuring credentials are validated and helpers are available before sign-in instructions are displayed.

title: #2382 Fix dependency artifact pattern for branch names with glob-special characters
summary: Fixed a bug where dependency artifact downloads failed silently when branch names contained special characters that minimatch interprets, such as commas, braces, or parentheses.

title: #2392 AL-Go Telemetry Enhancements: repository fork and hosting information
summary: AL-Go telemetry now captures whether a repository is a fork and its GitHub hosting type (GitHub.com, GHEC, or GHES), helping distinguish workflows across different environments without sending server details to telemetry.

title: #2395 Prevent workflow telemetry failures from failing the workflow
summary: WorkflowPostProcess telemetry failures no longer cause the entire workflow to fail, allowing GitHub API errors during finalization to remain visible in logs without blocking successful builds.

title: #10005 Improve error messages when there are no quantities to reverse in shipped/received lines in Sales/Purchase/Transfer
summary: Error messages when reversing shipped or received lines now distinguish between no reversible quantities and already-reversed lines, providing clearer guidance for users and AI agents.

title: #10007 [SOA] Ignore item availability when disabled
summary: The Sales Order Agent now ignores item availability signals when availability checking is disabled in settings, while still requesting assistance when no item is found.

title: #10008 [MCP] Add codeunit APIs as MCP tools in MCP configuration
summary: Codeunit APIs are now integrated into MCP configuration as a new object type alongside API pages and queries, with unified selection UI and metadata sourced from the Api Web Service table.

title: #10009 Disable low-usage Change Log Entry index
summary: The Change Log Entry table's Key4 index on Notification Message Id is disabled to improve write performance. The index showed negligible read usage (967 reads) compared to extremely high write maintenance costs (1.3 billion writes), making it a significant performance drain.

title: #10010 Add Report Inbox API pages for automated report retrieval
summary: Four new API pages expose Report Inbox data through the 'automate' API group, allowing Power Platform and OData clients to discover and download scheduled report outputs across single or multiple companies.

title: #10011 Improve performance when posting credit memos by skipping unnecessary lookups on empty keys
summary: Credit memo posting now skips unnecessary table lookups when source keys are empty, improving performance for both purchase and sales credit memos without changing functional behavior.

title: #10017 [Master] - Bug 644751 Moving an expense report line to another report wrongly reports a duplicate
summary: Fixed incorrect duplicate detection when moving an expense report line between open reports by excluding the source line from the validation check.

title: #10020 [Master] - Bug 641894: [Expense Agent] [Rules] Mileage expense should not validate require receipt number rule
summary: Mileage expenses in Expense Agent no longer incorrectly trigger the receipt number mandatory validation rule, since mileage never has receipts.

title: #10022 Known senders table should only be inserted to when the task is coming from an email
summary: The Known Senders table now only gets populated when tasks arrive from email, preventing unwanted entries when tasks are created by manually uploading PDFs.

title: #10023 [Master]-Customer Ledger Bill Entries display default Customer Posting Group instead of Alternative Customer Posting Group set on Sales Documents in the Spanish version.
summary: Invoice split payment posting in the Spanish version now preserves the alternative customer posting group from sales documents instead of defaulting to the customer's current posting group.

title: #10029 [Main]-Import of e-documents with format ZUGfERD & XRECHNUNG fail with error message You cannot insert a purchase line without a purchase header in German localisation
summary: A previous fix for e-document imports in German localisation is reverted because purchase and sales line handling was modified elsewhere, resolving errors during ZUGfERD and XRECHNUNG document imports.

title: #10030 [main]planning worksheet requires second runof calculate regenerative plan
summary: The low-level code calculation engine now processes SKU-level production BOMs correctly, ensuring planning worksheets generate all required planning lines in a single run for multi-level assemblies when BOMs are defined at the SKU level rather than the item card.

title: #10031 Add AI-assisted policy evaluation backend to Expense Agent
summary: Expense Agent now supports AI-assisted policy evaluation, storing immutable evaluation results for each policy and expense report subject, with new tables, pages, and APIs to track compliance status and enable policy validation at approval.

title: #10032 Fix Agent List and Agent Task List filter and refresh issues (AB#646062)
summary: Fixed filter visibility and refresh issues on Agent List and Agent Task List pages by moving system-managed filters from the user-owned filter group to the server-owned filter group, and updated the Archive action guard to re-read the agent state from the database instead of relying on cached page data.

title: #10034 [Shopify] Don't block Shops page when user lacks extension permissions
summary: The Shopify Shops page no longer fails to open on Belgian environments when users lack extension installation permissions. A permission error during the installation status check now skips the notification instead of blocking the page.

title: #10036 [SOA]: Bugbash for releases 28.x - Contact unable to find due to Qasim map to Megan, different names
summary: Sales Order Agent now correctly maps unknown senders to alternative contacts and routes replies to the mapped contact's email address while preserving thread context and original recipients.

title: #10041 [Master]-]G/L Account Sheet with Foreign Currency report (11564) includes LCY-originated entries after enabling G/L currency revaluation feature resulting in mixed-currency totals in the Swiss version. - Copy
summary: G/L Account Sheet with Foreign Currency report in Swiss version now correctly excludes local currency entries when G/L currency revaluation is enabled, ensuring totals reflect only foreign currency amounts.

title: #10098 Reenable Expense Agent VAT tests
summary: Tests for expense posting with VAT calculations in the Expense Agent are re-enabled by moving them from a disabled tests list back to the main test suite.

summary: The GSTR-1 report now handles B2B and B2C HSN summaries separately through conditional filtering based on the selected Nature of Supply, with fallback to combined output when no specific category is chosen.

title: #10101 [Master] [Expense Agent] Bug 641393 [AT] Recognize International Standard Code 1A as mileage UOM
summary: The mileage unit of measure filter now recognizes the Austrian 'Meilen' unit with International Standard Code 1A, allowing it to appear in the Default Mileage UOM selector in Expense Agent setup.

title: #10125 [Extensibility Request] issue 30395: expose production pick grouping number

title: #10126 [Extensibility Request] issue 30389: allow skipping service item confirmation

title: #10128 [Extensibility Request] issue 30357: add prepayment credit memo confirmation event
summary: A handled event is added to the prepayment credit memo posting process, allowing extensions to replace the standard confirmation dialog just as they can for prepayment invoices.

title: #10129 [Extensibility Request] issue 30342: allow skipping blocked item checks
summary: Service contract invoicing now allows extensions to skip blocked item and service item validation checks independently, enabling contracts to be invoiced when appropriate despite blocked or deleted references.

title: #10130 [ExpenseAgent] Expose VatSpecifications on Expense API Page
summary: The Expense API page now exposes VAT specifications through a new part, and a new capability is added to the Expense Agent for backwards compatibility.

title: #10131 [Extensibility Request] issue 30298: allow production scheduling direction control
summary: Production order line quantity changes can now be extended to control scheduling direction, allowing backward or forward rescheduling instead of only backward scheduling.

title: #10134 [Bug 646487] Composite layout: focus fix, body-layout gating, and setup UI
summary: Multiple bugs in composite layout management are fixed, including focus handling, multi-select deletion, configuration key conflicts, and layout subtype restrictions. UI labels are clarified and a Details FactBox replaces the Theme and Header/Footer Box.

title: #10135 [Master]-Performance issue when calculating the VAT advance return / VAT statement (Base Application, German environment) - Copy
summary: Removed database keys from the VAT Entry table in CH and DACH environments to prevent performance degradation on CRUD operations, reverting an earlier attempt to address VAT statement calculation issues.

title: #10136 [CH][SEPA CT] Export requires both IBAN and Clearing No. for domestic payments and refunds
summary: Swiss SEPA CT export now automatically extracts the clearing number from the IBAN when not explicitly provided, ensuring both values are populated for domestic payments and refunds.

title: #10141 [Quality Management] Make transaction blocked error more understandable and actionable

title: #10143 Handle non-invoice or currupt PDF extraction
summary: E-document extraction now detects non-invoice or corrupt PDFs that return empty data and stops with a clear error, preventing creation of empty drafts and unnecessary vendor searches.

title: #10149 Improve the Index Mgmt page discoverability
summary: Index Management page now opens directly from search and table selection dialogs, with improved navigation from Table Information. DateTime minimum values display as dashes instead of actual dates.

title: #10150 [Bug 617189] Clarify strict expiration posting tooltip
summary: The tooltip for Strict Expiration Posting in Item Tracking Code now clarifies that it uses First-Expired-First-Out picking for tracked items, independent of the location's FEFO setting.

title: #10151 Fix vendor contact relation read permission
summary: The VendCont-Update codeunit now elevates read permission to Contact Business Relation during vendor modification, allowing contact synchronization logic to execute properly without users needing additional direct permissions.

title: #10155 Slice 641293: [Expense Agent] Expense Locations and Per-diem rules in configurationAdded more locations
summary: Expense Agent now includes comprehensive expense locations for all country/regions with corresponding expense rule headers and conditions to support more detailed per-diem and rule configuration.

title: #10156 [Bug][SubscriptionBilling] Assign Subscription Lines dialog does not identify the sales line it was opened for
summary: The Assign Subscription Lines dialog now clearly identifies which sales line it is opened for by displaying the line number and description in its caption, and consolidates subscription package assignment logic to prevent duplicate dialogs when exploding bill-of-materials.

title: #10158 Add details to project sales tooltip
summary: Project Sales by Project chart now displays project description and customer name in the tooltip alongside the project number to help users identify projects and customers without reducing visual readability.

title: #10159 Warn when missing Power BI Account Categories Mappings
summary: A warning notification alerts users when Power BI Account Categories Mappings are missing during finance setup, helping them identify a common configuration issue.

title: #10162 Fix stale start status in e-document import pipeline
summary: The e-document import pipeline now uses the initial processing status instead of the post-undo status for telemetry emission and event triggering, fixing an edge case where no telemetry or event was sent after undoing to unprocessed.

title: #10164 Correction of where inventory valuation Power BI reports are shown
summary: Inventory valuation Power BI reports now appear only in the Business Manager Role Center with their own dedicated section, instead of being shown in the Finance Manager Role Center.

title: #10165 [Extensibility Request] issue 29901: expose item application entry before find
summary: An event is added before retrieving a filtered item application entry in the drop shipment undo process, allowing extensions with custom fields to adjust loaded fields and avoid JIT load-field errors.

title: #10166 [Extensibility Request] issue 29643: enable split transfer demand profiles
summary: Transfer demand profile handling now supports an event that allows extensions to create multiple profiles for different planning contexts, such as preserving distinct cable and cut-length requirements instead of aggregating quantities.

title: #10167 [Extensibility Request] issue 30240: add event before adding price list lines
summary: A cancellable event is added before price list line creation so extensions can implement custom logic or replace the standard line creation behavior.

title: #10168 [APAC] Keep vendor ACY on purchase invoice payables entry
summary: The posting engine in APAC regions now correctly preserves the vendor-calculated additional reporting currency on payables entries, preventing unbalanced ACY amounts and spurious residual entries when posting purchase invoices with blank currencies and non-zero vendor exchange rates.

title: #10169 [Extensibility Request] issue 30081: add VAT registration number override event
summary: An integration event allows extensions to override VAT registration number formatting in Intrastat reports before standard concatenation logic runs.

title: #10171 [Extensibility Request] issue 30110: add prepayment update events
summary: Sales prepayment posting now exposes two integration events that allow extensions to customize which lines are included in redistribution and modify each line before persistence without duplicating standard logic.

title: #10172 [Extensibility Request] issue 30111: add purchase prepayment update events
summary: Three integration events are added to the purchase prepayment line update procedure, allowing extensions to adjust line selection, handle missing-lines errors, and modify custom fields before each line update.

title: #10173 [Extensibility Request] issue 30129: expose manufacturing cost calculation events
summary: Manufacturing extensions can now separate setup and runtime costs during standard cost calculation by subscribing to new routing, cost-time, direct unit cost, and production order cost events in Calculate Standard Cost and Manufacturing Cost Calculation Management codeunits.

title: #10174 [Extensibility Request] issue 30137: allow overriding cost share application
summary: An integration event was added to the Cost Shares Breakdown report to allow extensions to override how cost share application calculates and applies cost values to capacity and overhead amounts.

title: #10176 [Main][all-e]Prepayment Invoice and Quantity Change Issue in Business Central
summary: Fixed an issue where prepayment invoices were not handled correctly when purchase or sales line quantities were changed, with updates applied across all localizations and new test cases added.

title: #10179 [master] Financial Report Recalculate clears Global Dimension filters
summary: Recalculating a financial report no longer clears Global Dimension filters on the Acc. Schedule Overview page. The fix preserves in-page filter values during recalculation.

title: #10182 [Bug]: [Subscription Billing] Payment discount on contract invoices comes from the customer, not from the contract's payment terms
summary: Payment discount percentages on subscription billing invoices now correctly use the contract's payment terms instead of the customer or vendor's payment terms.

summary: Sustainability Journal and Purchase Order lines now enforce field editability based on the selected account category's Calculation Foundation and Emission Scope, preventing users from editing formula inputs that are not supported by the chosen calculation method.

summary: The legacy data check for subcontracting now detects production-order-linked purchase and transfer orders to ensure migration runs when needed, and renames an internal function for clarity.

summary: The Purchase Journal page now refreshes its Document Amount field formatting when a vendor is validated, so it immediately reflects the correct decimal-place settings from the vendor's currency instead of retaining the previous format.

summary: The Calculate Inventory report now skips processing iterations when the Warehouse Entry table contains no records, improving performance for environments without warehouse functionality.

title: #10235 [Bug][SubscriptionBilling] Enforce Subscription Line Start Date change rules on all edit paths

title: #10247 [SOA] Show Cc recipients on email messages
summary: Sales Order Agent email cards now display Cc recipients in a read-only field, matching Business Central's Email Viewer formatting, with special handling for mapped-contact replies and calculation failures.

summary: Spend Request field numbers in the Posted Gen. Journal Line table are corrected to match the base W1 version across all country localizations.

summary: Shopify connector now normalizes phone numbers before search and verifies exact matches when finding existing customers, fixing incorrect duplicates with formatted phone numbers.

title: #10259 Slice 550732: Keep routing descriptions when vendor changes

summary: XML documentation for Quality Management procedures has been repaired and improved across numerous codeunits, tables, pages, and reports.

title: #10276 [master] Renewal Term field on the Create Contract Renewal Quote page does not accept the entered value such as 12M

title: #10277 Slice 554749: Inventory put-away/pick support for subcontracting purchase lines and WIP item transfers
summary: Inventory put-away and pick functionality is now supported for subcontracting purchase lines and WIP item transfers, with proper handling of quantities, item tracking, bin propagation, and partial posting scenarios.

title: #10278 Subcontracting Operation Notes

title: #10290 [Main] -Drop shipment undo receipt fails for service and non-inventory items.
summary: Undo receipt and undo shipment operations now work correctly for drop shipments involving service and non-inventory items by removing unnecessary cost application filters and adding a fallback lookup method through drop shipment links.

title: #10293 [Master] - Bug 641309: [Sustainability][Value Chain] Item Reclassification (location move) uses average emissions instead of Specific carbon tracking (lot/serial)

title: #10294 [SOA] Fix missing Agent Task Message read permission in contact search
summary: SOA Contact Search Impl now has read permission for Agent Task Message, allowing the Sales Order Agent to complete contact-mapping flows without permission intervention.

title: #10298 [main]A WIP Balance is presented incorrectly on the “Production Order – WIP” Report 5802 after Finishing Production Order Without Output Item Ledger Entry posted with new Manufacturing Setup option for no Output required.

title: #10301 [Master]-Bug 646962: Withholding Tax Posting Setup

title: #10302 [SOA] Clarify contact mapping options for unknown email senders

title: #10303 [Master]-Modifying a linked contact's common field clears the SIREN field on the associated customer record in the French version.

title: #10307 [Shopify] Fix Order Totals factbox opening an unrelated sales order for a linked posted invoice
summary: The Shopify Order Totals factbox now correctly resolves and displays totals for open sales orders, open sales invoices, and posted sales invoices by using the document link table, and navigates to the correct document type instead of always opening a sales order.

title: #10311 [Master] - Slice 640778: [Sustainability] Sustainability Entries should be more easy to find like other entries across BC

title: #10331 [Master]-Missing VAT Identifier in Peppol XML for Zero-Value Invoice

title: #10332 [Main]]No Employee posting group for AT when new employee is created

title: #10334 Add integration event OnAfterGetRecordOnAfterConfirmAndModify in the General Posting Setup dataitem OnAfterGetRecord trigger after Modify.

title: #10337 Let subscribers override the half-year new year date in SetHalfYearConventionMethod

title: #10341 Remove Anthropic privacy notice from Expense Agent

title: #10342 Add GLN information to XRechnung and ZUGFeRD exports
summary: GLN identifiers with schemeID 0088 are now included in German XRechnung and ZUGFeRD electronic document exports, respecting customer GLN settings and address hierarchy rules.

title: #10343 [Subcontracting] Bug 641241: Notify to install Subcontracting app in Subcontracting Worksheet

title: #123 Fix bridge skill manifest references after #122 root move
summary: The documentation for the bcquality-al-review bridge skill was updated to reflect the plugin manifest relocation from `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` to the repository root `plugin.json` after PR #122.

title: #124 Add FP guards: field relocation to tableextension + event parameter addition (bug 642303)
summary: BCQuality adds two false-positive guards to prevent incorrect breaking-change flags when relocating a field to a table extension or adding a parameter to an event publisher.

title: #125 knowledge(data-modeling): TableRelation delete/rename asymmetry and the xRec before-image contract
summary: Three data-modeling knowledge articles with executable tests clarify cascading delete behavior, TableRelation validation effects on rename propagation, and xRec before-image availability across different triggers.

title: #128 knowledge: improve review precision from BCApps PR 10080 feedback
summary: BCQuality knowledge articles improve precision based on feedback from BCApps code review runs, refining guidance on object affixes and error handling patterns.

title: #130 knowledge(performance): align SetLoadFields placement with AL Guidelines
summary: BCQuality aligned SetLoadFields code examples with AL Guidelines by placing filters before SetLoadFields, clarifying that this order is a readability convention rather than a performance requirement.

title: #131 Correct table-level data classification guidance
summary: Privacy guidance now correctly clarifies that table-level data classification is inherited by fields unless explicitly overridden, reducing false-positive guidance violations.

title: #132 Refine self-improvement review guidance
summary: BCQuality guidance refined to reduce false positives in event handling, UI testing, performance analysis, and label scope rules by narrowing criteria to match documented platform behavior and actual code semantics.

title: #133 Add TransferFields SkipFieldsNotMatchingType guidance
summary: Added guidance in BCQuality to warn developers against using TransferFields with SkipFieldsNotMatchingType as a blanket solution, as it can silently drop fields when type mismatches occur within the same extension.

title: #134 knowledge(performance): add community rules for performance
summary: Community performance guidance is added to the quality repository with 16 AL code examples covering partial records, HTTP deferral, multi-company access, page I/O, number-series batching, and database patterns.

title: #135 Correct severe misconception about SetCurrentKey in the knowledge base
summary: Documentation corrected to clarify that SetCurrentKey only affects SQL sort order, not index selection by SQL Server, removing outdated guidance that misled AL developers.

title: #136 Add community knowledge: AL boolean operators do not short-circuit
summary: Two community knowledge articles explain AL's lack of short-circuit evaluation for boolean operators and recommend using case statements as alternatives for complex condition chains.

title: #137 Add community guidance and review support for Business Central agents
summary: Business Central agent developers gain 20 community-authored guidance rules covering agent registration, permissions, profiles, instructions, session handling, and lifecycle management, with good and bad code examples for each rule.

title: #138 knowledge(style): event subscribers bind by parameter name, so a shorter list is not a mismatch
summary: The style guide for event subscribers is clarified to document the actual behavior that AL binds subscribers by parameter name rather than position, allowing subscribers to omit parameters and reorder them without it being a mismatch.

title: #139 knowledge(breaking-changes): adding a parameter to an event publisher is not a signature break
summary: The breaking-changes knowledge article now clarifies that adding a parameter to an event publisher is not a breaking change, since event subscribers bind by parameter name, not position. This aligns the article with the existing events knowledge and removes a false positive report.

title: #142 Add AL-focused AppSource validation guidance
summary: Seven new AppSource validation guidance articles added to help AL developers avoid common issues like hardcoded time zones, UI calls in web services, and missing usage categories on entry points.

title: #144 Avoid Public Event publisher
summary: A new knowledge article explains that event publishers should be declared local or internal rather than public, since the access modifier controls who can raise the event (not who can subscribe), and public publishers create immutable caller contracts after release. Four existing Microsoft-layer publishers had their unnecessary public access modifiers removed.

title: #145 Process Context via manual event subscriber pattern
summary: Adds community knowledge article documenting how to expose process context to extensions using manual event subscriber bindings tied to variable scope instead of singleton flags that persist across failed transactions.

title: #146 knowledge: three false-positive guards from BCApps PR 10277, 10278 and 10346
summary: Quality rules were refined to eliminate false positives about missing cleanups in insert-only transfers, mandatory affixes in non-AppSource apps, and permission context lowering in tests. Three knowledge articles were added or updated with better preconditions to keep genuine defects reportable.

title: #147 ShowMandatory + OnQueryClosePage Check
summary: Two new UI community knowledge articles with code examples demonstrate best practices for marking required fields and validating request page input to prevent common defects like fields appearing optional or losing user input on validation errors.

title: #148 Add Job Queue reliability and scheduling guidance
summary: Six new performance guidance articles document reliability and scheduling practices for Job Queue and Task Scheduler workloads, including idempotency requirements, UI independence, failure propagation, category-based serialization, on-hold behavior, and duplicate task prevention.

title: #149 knowledge(web-services): under schema 2.0 an API enum field is a contract by member name, under 1.0 by caption
summary: A knowledge article clarifies how API enum fields are published: under schema 2.0 by member name with captions in entityDefinitions, under schema 1.0 by en-US caption as Edm.String. Good and bad code samples demonstrate the contract implications.

title: #150 Simplify standalone AL code review skill
summary: The standalone AL code review skill is renamed from bcquality-al-review to al-code-review, with its SKILL.md simplified to a thin adapter that delegates to internal Entry and coordinator components. Plugin manifests and version are updated accordingly.

title: #152 knowledge(events): ChangeCompany leaves triggers and trigger-event subscribers running in the calling company
summary: A knowledge article documents that ChangeCompany does not move trigger execution context to the target company; triggers and trigger-event subscribers still run in the calling company. StartSession is recommended for cross-company operations that require proper trigger handling.

title: #153 Promote knowledge for Microsoft-owned review skills
summary: Twenty-nine knowledge articles and fifty-six sample files were moved from the Community layer to the Microsoft layer in the quality rules repository to keep skill ownership aligned with knowledge authority.

title: #156 18 AL/BC patterns: style, data-modeling, web-services, appsource, breaking-changes, performance, testing
summary: 18 new AL/BC development patterns added covering style conventions, data modeling, web services, AppSource, breaking changes, performance, and testing guidance with code examples.

title: #157 18 more AL/BC patterns: data-modeling, testing, style, security, error-handling, ui, upgrade, web-services, appsource
summary: BCQuality adds 18 new knowledge articles covering data modeling, testing, style, security, error handling, UI, upgrade, web services, and AppSource patterns with code examples and best practices.

title: #158 3 AL/BC patterns from CURABIS's internal automated-testing training material
summary: Four new AL/BC best practice patterns were added covering item ledger entry document numbers after combined posting and three testing approaches for verifying field UI state and generating unique test values.

title: #159 3 AL/BC testing patterns from an external BC testing expert's blog (Luc van Vugt, fluxxus.nl)
summary: Three AL testing patterns from an external BC expert's blog are documented as best practices: using events to exclude invalid table relations in tests, committing shared test fixtures before lazy initialization, and using Assert.IsFalse for boolean checks instead of asserterror.

title: #160 Clarify page field caption and tooltip inheritance
summary: Quality rules now clarify that bound page fields inherit Caption and ToolTip from source table fields, reducing false recommendations for redundant properties and aligning guidance with runtime behavior.

title: #161 AL methods limited during write transactions (RunModal, Codeunit.Run)
summary: New performance guidance documents platform restrictions on calling RunModal and Codeunit.Run methods during write transactions, explaining when each method is blocked and how to structure code to avoid triggering the runtime error.

title: #172 Support standalone runners and complete app-folder reviews
summary: AL review skills now support standalone runners and folder-based app reviews by decoupling scheduling concerns and enabling parallel execution of independent review domains while maintaining deterministic result ordering.

title: #173 Frame app review as one standalone plugin example
summary: BCQuality documentation now presents the project as a general skill plugin model with app review as one example, removing code-review-specific framing and external orchestrator references.

title: #174 Make BCQuality documentation easier for partners to get started
summary: BCQuality documentation is reorganized to guide partners through practical first-use paths, leading with CLI prerequisites and plugin installation rather than internal architecture. Sample references across knowledge articles become clickable links, and the Community Agents review gains folder-path support.

title: #175 9 AL/BC patterns: document distribution, price calculation & barcode extensibility
summary: Nine new AL/BC patterns document best practices for document distribution, report selections, price calculation extensibility, barcode usage, and posting-cascade field mirroring, with verified examples from Business Central source.

title: #176 Complete partner contribution and knowledge consumption guides
summary: Documentation expanded to guide partners on reading quality knowledge, contributing articles, and consuming skills in custom agents, with clarifications on metadata, integration, and SetLoadFields guidance.

title: #177 Add retention policy knowledge to the privacy domain
summary: Added guidance to the privacy domain in BCQuality about registering extension-owned tables for retention policies and shipping default retention policy setups, addressing common mistakes in how extensions handle log table cleanup.

title: #178 Separate deterministic analyzer rules from BCQuality
summary: Deterministic analyzer rules and their documentation are removed from BCQuality, leaving only knowledge that adds BC-specific context beyond what the compiler already enforces.

title: #179 Add bounded knowledge retrieval
summary: Added deterministic, lossless bounded knowledge retrieval for review skills that caps context at 16,000 UTF-8 bytes per page, returns all applicable catalog rows without filtering or ranking, and validates retrieval through GUID-scoped scratch paths to improve efficiency and validation reliability.

title: #180 Normalize recoverable leaf finding ranges
summary: The review quality system now normalizes location range data in performance audit findings when the line number falls within the valid range, preserving other content and improving valid finding recovery without repairing invalid JSON or other structural issues.

title: #182 Add machine-readable review orchestration contract
summary: BCQuality now generates a deterministic, machine-readable skill index from review frontmatter and validates review composition through schemas and CI checks.

title: #183 Add reporting review guidance and evaluation fixtures
summary: Nine reporting rules and guidance articles have been added to the BCQuality knowledge base covering report variable clearing, CurrReport control flow, report extensions, table view narrowing, and request page cancellation.

title: #184 Fix Job Queue knowledge sample links
summary: Job Queue knowledge articles were corrected to use relative Markdown links for code samples instead of inline code references, restoring the proper format required by the knowledge retrieval system.

title: #186 Add Query filter semantics guidance
summary: Documentation added explaining how DataItemTableFilter and ColumnFilter behave with runtime filters in queries, with examples and validation through the Query review skill.

title: #187 Code reviewer skill for recognizing and validating unauthenticated responses
summary: A new code reviewer skill was added to detect unauthenticated URL usage and validate the required response checks that must be enforced in those scenarios.

title: #192 Add SCM functional knowledge domain
summary: SCM (supply chain management) functional knowledge domain added with nine scoped rules and self-contained AL code samples covering item posting, reservations, warehouse adjustments, and requisition workflows.

title: #193 Clarify locale-safe DateFormula Evaluate inputs
summary: Adds a Microsoft Style article clarifying that DateFormula Evaluate calls require language-independent literals to work correctly in non-English localizations, addressing a localization gap where such calls could fail despite correct downstream CalcDate typing.

title: #195 Add foundational AL developer knowledge
summary: Five foundational AL development guidelines are added covering document initialization, rounding operations, interface casting, UI refresh behavior, and upgrade execution order.

title: #196 Strengthen review contracts and add AL reliability guidance
summary: Five new AL reliability rules are added with good/bad code samples covering data handling, security, testing, and web service integration, alongside framework improvements for deterministic review execution and layered rule precedence.

title: #198 Add BC performance knowledge from OptimAL learnings
summary: Added six new performance guidance articles with code examples and refined existing guidance on indexing, buffered inserts, aggregate processing, and FlowField caching based on the OptimAL Performance Initiative.

title: #199 Fix indirect permission letters: `ri` is indirect read plus insert
summary: A security best practice article now correctly explains that permission letters r, i, m, d each represent one permission (read, insert, modify, delete), and corrects its examples to avoid over-granting indirect permissions.

title: #202 Restore deterministic review fixture coverage
summary: Quality review fixtures now register 23 knowledge articles with deterministic coverage, including retrieval keywords to ensure clean and positive controls remain discoverable within the bounded candidate set.

title: #203 knowledge(data-modeling): Prices Including VAT decides the basis of sales/purchase/service line amounts
summary: A knowledge article clarifies how the Prices Including VAT header flag affects the basis of line amount fields in sales, purchase, and service documents, distinguishing fields that follow the flag from those with fixed net or gross basis.

title: #204 Validate composed reviews against the expected leaf worklist
summary: Composed review validation now enforces that selected leaf worklists are executed in order and completeness is verified through expected manifests, preventing inconsistent reports that omit required domains.

title: #205 Preserve business filters when recommending Record.Get
summary: The performance guidance for replacing FindFirst with Record.Get now clarifies that additional business filters must be preserved, either by keeping the filtered FindFirst or by enforcing equivalent conditions after Get.

title: #207 2 AL/BC UI patterns: client-expression in-list (AL0573) and Role Center AccessByPermission
summary: Two new UI pattern articles document how to avoid client expression issues in page fields and how to properly gate role center visibility by permissions using AccessByPermission instead of triggers or procedures.

title: #208 2 AL/BC patterns: TableRelation field length and RecordRef.Open Temp parameter
summary: Two new knowledge articles identify silent runtime mismatches in table relations and record reference calls that compile without diagnostic warnings. The articles explain the exact rules for field length matching and the pitfalls of using RecordRef.Open with the temporary parameter flag.

title: #209 3 AL/BC patterns: Insert/Delete trigger defaults on master data and declined Confirm in OnValidate
summary: Three new articles guide developers to use triggers when writing or deleting master data and to properly abort validations when user confirmation is declined.

title: #210 knowledge(upgrade): upgrade code must not use ChangeCompany
summary: New quality rule and knowledge article prevent upgrade code from using ChangeCompany, which can cause data races, duplicate upgrades, and trigger misexecution in the calling company context.

title: #213 knowledge(events): database trigger setup flags may only be set to true
summary: A new quality rule checks that database trigger setup flags in the Global Triggers event can only be set to true, preventing subscribers from inadvertently clearing flags set by other integrations or system features.

title: #214 UI knowledge: notification recall needs a known Id; open mixed-type documents through Page Management
summary: Two new UI design guidance articles added to help developers properly manage notifications by using known IDs for recall and handle multi-document routing through Page Management instead of hard-coded mappings.

title: #215 knowledge(performance): grouped query (Count + ColumnFilter = HAVING) for distinct values and duplicates
summary: A new performance knowledge article teaches developers how to use query objects with grouped methods and column filters to detect duplicate values in a single SQL statement instead of looping with multiple queries.

title: #216 knowledge(style): a new procedure that changes the page's current record should take it as var Record
summary: New style guidance document for AL developers on when procedures that modify a record should take the record as a var parameter, with good and bad code samples and exclusions.

Finding IDs must not contain citation fragments, uncited findings are restricted to medium/low confidence and minor/info severity, and a checklist clarifies proper handling of citation paths and line numbering.

title: #49 Promote security knowledge from community to Microsoft layer
summary: Five security knowledge articles moved from the community layer to the Microsoft layer with minor content refinements to remove non-existent references and contribution prompts.

title: #54 Emit human-readable domain label on review findings
summary: Review findings now include a human-readable domain label owned by BCQuality, eliminating the need for consumer taxonomy maps and allowing new review domains to render correctly without engine changes.

summary: Security and privacy knowledge articles were corrected to align with current Business Central APIs and behavior, including fixes for SecretText HTTP guidance, error telemetry semantics, field data classification, and consent handling.

summary: Multiple performance knowledge articles were refined to correct semantic guidance on partial records, transactions, N+1 queries, SIFT indexes, bulk writes, and read isolation, with unsafe examples replaced and two overly broad rules removed.
